PSSSB Technical Assistant 2027 - Eligibility & Selection

Technical Assistant means different posts in different departments. What each asked for, and the 2027 outlook.

I cleared the Punjab Police Sub Inspector exam with Rank 2 (713/800). Technical Assistant is one of the better-paid PSSSB posts at Level-6, but the title confuses people: different departments use it for completely different jobs. Read the department line before you prepare.

The latest round was PSSSB Advertisement No. 12 of 2025 - 2 Technical Assistant posts (Group-B) in the Directorate of SC Sub-Plan, applications 1 to 23 December 2025. Before that, Advt 01/2024 (published 9 February 2024) had 6 Technical Assistant and 12 District Technical Coordinator posts in the Department of Administrative Reforms. No 2027 notification has been released yet.

Will there be posts in 2027?

PSSSB has advertised Technical Assistant posts in 2021, 2024 and 2025, each time for a different department. That pattern means a 2027 advertisement is quite possible, but you cannot predict which degree it will ask for. If you hold a master's in Statistics or Economics or a B.Tech in IT or CS, keep an eye on PSSSB notices; posts are few, so competition per post is high.

Eligibility - the two latest advertisements

Advt 12/2025Advt 01/2024
DepartmentDirectorate of SC Sub-PlanAdministrative Reforms
Posts2 Technical Assistant6 Technical Assistant + 12 District Technical Coordinator
DegreeMaster's in Economics, Mathematics, Agri Economics, Commerce with Statistics, or Statistics - 50% (or below 50% with one year of statistical work)B.E./B.Tech in IT, ECE or CS with 50%, or a master's in Computer
PayRs 35,400 (Level-6)Rs 35,400 (Level-6)

Matric-level Punjabi is required for both.

Age and fee

  • Age: 18 to 37 years; up to 42 for SC and BC of Punjab, 45 for government employees, 47 for persons with disabilities, 40 for widows and divorcees.
  • Fee: General Rs 1,000; SC/BC/EWS Rs 250; ex-servicemen Rs 200; persons with disabilities Rs 500.

Selection process

StageWhatRole
Part AMatric-level Punjabi (MCQ)Qualifying - at least 50%
Written examObjective paperMerit list
CounsellingDocumentsFinal step
  • Marking: 1 mark per question, 1/4 mark cut for each wrong answer (standard PSSSB rule).
  • For Advt 12/2025 the board said the syllabus would be uploaded later; check its website before the exam.

How to prepare

  1. Solve the 2021 paper. We have the Technical Assistant paper of 22 August 2021 with its key to see the level.
  2. Treat your degree as 70% of the job. Statistics candidates: sampling, index numbers, regression, official statistics. IT candidates: networks, DBMS, OS and programming.
  3. Keep GK and Punjabi ticking over. In a 2-post exam, every general mark matters.
  4. Have your mark sheets ready. The 50% rule and the experience exception are checked closely.

Straight answers

Frequently asked questions

What is the qualification for PSSSB Technical Assistant?

It depends on the department. Advt 12/2025 (Directorate of SC Sub-Plan) asked for a master's in Economics, Mathematics, Agricultural Economics, Commerce with Statistics, or Statistics. Advt 01/2024 (Administrative Reforms) asked for a B.E./B.Tech in IT, ECE or CS with 50%, or a master's in Computer.

What is the salary of PSSSB Technical Assistant?

Rs 35,400 at Pay Level-6 of the 7th CPC pay matrix in both the 2024 and 2025 advertisements.

How is merit made for Technical Assistant?

Through an objective written exam. Merit is drawn from the written marks, and since October 2022 a qualifying matric-level Punjabi paper (50%) is also part of every PSSSB exam.

Is there a syllabus for the 2025 Technical Assistant exam?

Advt 12/2025 said the syllabus would be uploaded later on the board's website. Expect a large share from your own degree subject, plus GK, reasoning and languages.

Will there be a Technical Assistant recruitment in 2027?

No 2027 notification yet. PSSSB advertised Technical Assistant posts in 2021, 2024 and 2025 for different departments, so another department could ask for them in 2027, but the posts are few and the degree needed changes each time.
